reason: My mum already sends me recipes on LINE for free, and most days a 50-baht plate from the street is easier than cooking for one. I'd download it and try the free green curry, but 99 baht is two dinners for dishes I'd maybe cook once.
objection: Cooking just for me rarely comes out cheaper or quicker than street food, and when I get stuck the help is still typing. With curry paste on my fingers I'd rather send mum a voice message.
would_change_my_mind: If one Sunday plan were free, so I could see that a week of cooking for one really costs less than buying 50-baht plates before I pay.
